leadText: (Japanese: 再びめぐりあった相棒 Partners Reunited Once More) is the fourth chapter of the Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blazing Exploration Team manga.
plainText:
(Japanese: 再びめぐりあった相棒 Partners Reunited Once More) is the fourth chapter of the Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blazing Exploration Team manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Grovyle and Honō are revealed to have been partners that tried to go into the past and change the Dark Future.
Celebi sacrifices herself to allow the others to go back in time.
Honō, Totodile, and Grovyle manage to make it back to the past.
Grovyle leaves to gather the Time Gears again while Honō and Totodile go to find information on the Hidden Land.
Honō and Totodile reunite with the other Wigglytuff Guild members, only to find the whole town frozen in time.

===Debuts===
